title: Modality Fault Lines: Structural Corruptions Reveal Fragile Omni-Modal Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2608.29278v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Omni-modal large language models are increasingly evaluated on clean text--vision--audio inputs, where every channel is present, synchronized, and readily interpretable. Such scores are often taken as evidence of robust cross-modal fusion, but clean evaluation cannot tell whether success depends on stable cross-modal structure or on cues sufficient only in intact inputs. To address this gap, we define a modality fault line: a boundary at which model behavior becomes unstable when a modality remains present and human-interpretable, but its internal evidence structure is perturbed. We introduce SCEval (Structure-Corruption Evaluation) a diagnostic evaluation protocol that keeps the question, answer space, and modality channels fixed while applying controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio individually and jointly. translated_title: 模态断层线：结构损坏揭示脆弱的全模态推理
translated_abstract: 全模态大语言模型越来越多地在干净的文本-视觉-音频输入上进行评估，其中每个通道都存在、同步且易于解释。这样的分数常被视为稳健跨模态融合的证据，但干净的评估无法判断成功究竟依赖于稳定的跨模态结构，还是仅依赖于完整输入中才足够的线索。为填补这一空白，我们定义了“模态断层线”：当某个模态仍然存在且对人类可解释，但其内部证据结构受到扰动时，模型行为变得不稳定的边界。我们引入SCEval（结构损坏评估），一种诊断性评估协议，它保持问题、答案空间和模态通道固定不变，同时对文本、视觉和音频分别及联合地施加受控的结构性损坏。SCEval基于来自Social-IQ、OmniBench和VALOR的273个经人工验证的三模态样本构建，评估……
tldr: 提出SCEval诊断评估协议，在保持问题与模态通道不变的前提下对文本、视觉和音频施加受控结构损坏，定义“模态断层线”，揭示全模态大语言模型在模态内部证据结构被扰动时的脆弱推理能力。
en_tdlr: SCEval applies controlled structural corruptions to text, vision, and audio while keeping questions and modality channels fixed, defining "modality fault lines" that expose the fragile reasoning of omni-modal LLMs when a modality remains present and human-interpretable but its internal evidence structure is perturbed.
